categories.main_business_segments: Yadea Group Holdings Ltd. primarily operates in two segments: (1) Electric two-wheeled vehicles and related accessories, including electric scooters and electric bicycles; and (2) Batteries and electric drives. The company focuses on the design, research, development, manufacturing, and sales of these products.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company emphasizes innovation in electric vehicle technology, including batteries and electronic control systems. It operates six R&D centers, one design center, and three CNAS laboratories with over 1,000 R&D experts and holds more than 2,000 patents. Production is carried out in eight self-operated facilities across China, Vietnam, and Indonesia, with an annual production capacity of approximately 20 million electric two-wheeled vehicles.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Yadea serves a broad customer base through a domestic distribution network of over 3,660 distributors and 40,000 points of sale in China. Internationally, it has established distribution channels in over 100 countries across Europe, Southeast Asia, South America, and Central America. The company targets consumers seeking premium electric two-wheeled vehicles and green mobility solutions.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company’s operations are primarily based in the People's Republic of China, with production facilities in multiple Chinese cities including Wuxi, Qingyuan, Ningbo, Jinzhai, Chongqing, and Tianjin. It has expanded its manufacturing and sales footprint to Southeast Asia, with facilities and retail presence in Vietnam and Indonesia, and sales operations in over 100 countries globally.
categories.supply_chain_position: Yadea operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the electric two-wheeled vehicle supply chain, encompassing product design, R&D, manufacturing, and sales. It controls production facilities and distribution networks, indicating an integrated supply chain position from manufacturing to retail.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes technological innovation, particularly in battery technology, including the development of sodium-ion battery-powered electric bicycles. It focuses on compliance with evolving national safety standards, product lineup optimization, and global expansion, especially in Southeast Asia. Marketing efforts target younger consumers through digital platforms and brand ambassadors to enhance engagement.
categories.revenue_model: Yadea generates revenue primarily through the sale of electric two-wheeled vehicles (electric scooters and bicycles), batteries and chargers, and vehicle parts. Revenue is recognized at the point of sale, with no significant reliance on subscription or licensing models.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Yadea is positioned as a leading premium brand in the electric two-wheeled vehicle industry in China and globally. It has maintained the top-selling brand status for eight consecutive years and surpassed 100 million cumulative sales worldwide. The report does not specify competitors by name but highlights Yadea’s market leadership and resilience amid industry challenges.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, Yadea reported revenue of RMB 28.24 billion, a decrease of 18.8% from 2023, and a profit attributable to owners of RMB 1.27 billion, down 51.8%. The company has over 12,000 employees and an annual production capacity of approximately 20 million units. Despite short-term market headwinds, Yadea maintains a strong financial base with RMB 7.87 billion in cash and cash equivalents and a healthy liquidity position.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Yadea emphasizes superior green mobility solutions with a focus on safety, quality, and innovation. Its extensive R&D capabilities, patent portfolio, and adherence to international standards differentiate its products. The company offers diverse designs and functionalities catering to broad customer needs and is advancing sustainable technologies such as sodium-ion batteries to enhance energy density, cost efficiency, and environmental sustainability.
